growth.title: Riyadh Air gets approval to fly to United States
growth.description: Riyadh Air has received approval from the US Department of Transportation (DoT) to operate flights between Saudi Arabia and the United States. risk.title: Australia eases travel advice for GCC nations
risk.description: Australia has eased its travel advice for four GCC countries following the signing of a peace deal by the US and Iran. Travel advice for the UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar has been lowered from Level 4 “Do not travel” to Level 3 “Reconsider your need to travel”, Australia’s foreign affairs minister Penny Wong said. risk.title: UAE’s 2025 tax revenue increases 15%
risk.description: The UAE collected more than AED46 billion ($12.5 billion) in value-added tax (VAT) and excise tax in 2025, up 15 percent from AED41 billion in 2024, the finance ministry has said. The taxes were distributed among federal and local governments, Mohamed bin Hadi Al Hussaini, minister of state for financial affairs, said in a statement. […]
